summary: Bakkt, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, Bakkt Opco Holdings, LLC, was allotted 47,500,000 warrants from Transchem Ltd. in a preferential allotment, paying $9,409,784 (25% of total). This is an investment rather than a transformative special situation. There is no M&A, activist, or strategic review. The warrants entitle the holder to acquire Transchem ordinary shares. The filing does not specify a board recommendation or advisor, and there is no regulatory clock or arbitrage angle. The event is a routine equity investment disclosure, not a special situation.
